titulo: Using the near future ir a (not the present progressive) for plans
subtitulo: The everyday future in Spanish, and why «mañana estoy trabajando» is wrong.
regla: For a plan that is already decided, use ir a + infinitive. Estar + gerund is only for what is happening right now.

bloques.texto: When something is already decided or arranged, Spanish uses **ir a** + infinitive. English uses _-ing_ for this (_I'm working tomorrow_); Spanish does not.
The **a** is never left out: **voy a abrir**, never **voy abrir**. If the conjugation slips, review [[5271|**ir** in the present]].
Tip: if the sentence has **mañana** in it, it doesn't take **-ando**.

lista.es: Mañana ==voy a abrir== un Tsuru a las siete.
lista.en: I'm opening a Tsuru tomorrow at seven.

lista.es: Mi cliente ==va a pasar== por la llave a las cinco.
lista.en: My customer is picking up the key at five.

lista.es: El sábado ==vamos a surfear== en Baja Malibú.
lista.en: We're surfing at Baja Malibu on Saturday.

lista.es: ¿==Vas a entrenar== jiu-jitsu hoy en la noche?

bloques.texto: [[5092|**Estar** + gerund]] is only for what is happening at this moment. If the sentence has a future time (tomorrow, on Saturday, at five), use **ir a**.

filas.t: Mañana estoy trabajando hasta las seis.
Mañana voy a trabajar hasta las seis.
El martes estoy yendo al dentista.
El martes voy a ir al dentista.

lista.nota: **Voy a ir**: **ir** twice, and it's perfectly correct.
This one is right: it's happening right now.

lista.texto: A plan already decided. In spoken Mexican Spanish, this is the everyday future.
Also fine when you say when. It sounds like a schedule or a fixed thing. See [[5993|the present for the future]].
More formal or written. This is the [[5155|simple future]]. In speech it is often used [[5060|to guess]]: **¿Dónde estará?**
Only right now. Never for a plan.

bloques.texto: The pronoun goes before **ir** or attached to the infinitive, never in between. The full rule is in [[7426|pronouns with infinitives]].

lista.forma: Iba a llamarte, pero se me fue el día.
lista.texto: [[6003|**Iba a** + infinitive]]: what you were going to do.
**Vamos a** also invites, like _let's_. To leave, **vámonos**: see [[9262|reflexive commands]].
[[6509|**Estar a punto de**]]: it's about to happen.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I'm going to the dentist on Tuesday._
lista.r: El martes voy a ir al dentista.
lista.nota: It's a plan. **Estoy yendo** would mean you're on your way right now.

lista.p: Which one? **El viernes estamos cenando con mis papás** or **El viernes vamos a cenar con mis papás**.
lista.r: El viernes vamos a cenar con mis papás.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I can't talk, I'm driving._
lista.nota: Here **estar** + gerund is right: it's happening now.
